content: पराभवः .²1 .³({%a%}) Defeat, discomfiture, overthrow; पराभवोऽप्युत्सव एव मानिनाम् <ls>Ki. 1. 41</ls>. .³({%b%}) Mortification, humiliation; कुबेरस्य मनःशल्यं शंसतीव पराभवम् <ls>Ku. 2. 22</ls>; तव पदपल्लववैरिपराभवमिदमनुभवतु सुवेशम् <ls>Gīt. 12</ls>. .²2 Contempt, disregard, disrespect. .²3 Destruction. .²4 Disappearance, separation (sometimes written पराभाव). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the 40th year in the cycle of 60 years.
